s.n: R16 Sacro Monte SS.Trinità di Ghiffa - Pollino
s.da: Sacro Monte S.S.Trinità di Ghiffa (diramazione R30 - R30e) (m 375)
s.nota: Route between the Sacro Monte SS. Trinità, World Heritage of Humanity, and Pollino: inside broad-leaved woods, Special Nature Reserve, at times steep pass by the Sabbia Rossa Chapel and the Streghe little lake. Views on Lake Maggiore.

s.n: R16a Diramazione R16 Sacro Monte di Ghiffa - Diramazione R16 Laghetto delle Streghe (Pollino)
s.da: Diramazione R16 Sacro Monte di Ghiffa (m 425)
s.nota: Direct path from Sacro Monte SS Trinità to Pollino (Witches pond) alternative to R16. From the ruins of the Cappella di Mezzo recommended for expert hikers, mostly steep, some steps on small rocks and exposed sections in the upper part.

From Gonte to Manegra via Alpe Casola. Start between inhabited hamlets, then trail with some steep parts, from A.Casola forest road. From Cappella S.Maria to A.Casola poor maintenance; difficult passage in small valley ~780 m under A.Casola.

s.n: R24b Cappella S.Maria bivio R24 - Manegra bivio R10
s.da: Cappella S.Maria sopra Mozzola, bivio R24 (m 520)
s.nota: Direct path to Alpe Manegra starting from the Cappella di S. Maria at the crossroad with R24 for Alpe Casola. Path marked by white paint sometimes faded and difficult to identify.

s.n: R30b Gonte SS34 - Gonte diramazione R30
s.nota: From the SS34 of Lago Maggiore with a short path you go up to Gonte, you pass near the Parish Church of S. Pietro and you reach the R30 path "Via delle Genti".
From Travallino, hamlet of Oggebbio, P.zza chiesa Sant'Antonio, through hamlets Piazza, Dumera, Casere Comino, up to Luera, crossroads with R10, R12, R14, R18.

s.n: R30c Pieggio porto - Travallino diramazione R30
s.nota: From Pieggio (port of Oggebbio), climb up passing from the P.zza chiesa di S. Rocco to reach Travallino (Oggebbio), P.zza chiesa di Sant'Antonio, intersection with the routes R30 and R22.
The route starts from Camogno, at the junction with the provincial road where passes the Via delle Genti (R30) and ends at Luera, crossroads with the routes R10, R12, R14, R22.

s.n: R02 Verbania Intra bivio R30 Via Selasca - Arizzano - Albagnano - Premeno - Pizzo d'Omo
s.da: Verbania Intra bivio R30 Via Selasca (m 210)
s.nota: From Verbania Intra crossroads R30 Via Selasca through Pastura, Antoliva, Cresseglio, Cissano, Arizzano, Albagnano, then the holiday resorts Premeno and Pian di Sole, to climb to Pizzo d'Omo (m 1056) and finish at the crossroads of the path R02,R02A,R10.

s.a: Nord Pizzo d'Omo bivio percorso R10 (m 920)
s.nota: From Premeno,crossroad R02,in direction of Le Australie,go up the provincial road to Pollino,after about 300 m deviate into V.Manegra. A path on the left leads to Sasso Mezzano with a wonderful view of Lago Maggiore,then to the crossroad with R10.

s.n: R10 Sacro Monte S.S.Trinità di Ghiffa - Pollino - Piancavallo - Colle - Passo Folungo
s.da: Sacro Monte SS. Trinità di Ghiffa, bivio R30 (m 392)
s.a: Passo Folungo, bivio R11, R19, R20, S15 (m 1369)
s.nota: Long route from the Sacro Monte SS.Trinità di Ghiffa,Sanctuary and Unesco Heritage,to Passo Folungo,between Valle Intrasca and Cannobina,through Caronio,Pollino,Luera,Manegra, Piancavallo,crossroads for Cima Morissolo,Colle,Pian d'Arla and Pian Puzz.
The route starts from Aurano, crosses some little valleys to reach the Alpe Erbia and then, with a flat path, reaches Luera, crossroads the R10, R12, R18, R22 routes.

s.n: R30 'Via delle Genti': tratto Cannero - Oggebbio - Sacro Monte SS.Trinità di Ghiffa - Verbania Intra
s.nota: Historic "Via delle Genti". Route from Cannero to Intra through the numerous hamlets of Oggebbio. Superb panoramic view of Lake Maggiore in a succession of frescoed oratories and chapels. Sacro Monte SS.Trinità di Ghiffa, Sanctuary and Unesco Heritage.
The route, in the woods on the hillside, starts from the square of Esio on a paved road, then continues on a gravel road and on a path, then on a cart track it reach Luera.

s.n: R30e Ghiffa - Sacro Monte SS.Trinità di Ghiffa
s.a: Sacro Monte SS.Trinità di Ghiffa, bivio R30 (m 380)
s.nota: Route between Ghiffa lakefront and Sacro Monte of SS. Trinità, initially on an asphalt road, then on path at times steep. The Sacro Monte is a World Heritage Site and a Special Nature Reserve. Magnificent dominant position on Lake Maggiore.
The path starts from the SS 34 of Lago Maggiore under Camogno to reach Camogno at the crossroads with R30 Via delle Genti.

s.n: Grand Tour del Lago Maggiore ® - Tappa 11 - Cannobio - Verbania lntra
s.nota: An 11-stage trek that brings together and connects ancient historical routes, paths and pre-existing trails on the shores and hills surrounding Lake Maggiore, designed by CAI Sezione Verbano Intra. Descriptions are available on the Website.

Wonderful path up to the peak. Some parts are very steep and path is not always easy to find. GPS track might help.
